honest_access_summary: No public cohort was found that ships per-patient longitudinal ctDNA tumor fraction paired with a platinum-resistance label as an open download. The strongest calibratable route is BriTROC-1 plasma sWGS (TIER1_DIRECT, EGA-controlled, overlaps W3); the rest are prognostic-only or require author/consortium requests. This is reported honestly: direct wiring of ctDNA into predict_resistance needs a TIER1 cohort that must be applied for — it is not satisfiable from open data today.
